# Purpose {#sec-purpose}

This notebook fits the hierarchical BCF (`multibart`, country random intercepts only) on the extended analysis tibble from `10_data_prep_ext.qmd`, for both game outcomes.
Scope is **fitting and saving only**, as in `05_bcf_fit.qmd`.
`prep_game()` and `fit_bcf()` are copied verbatim from `05_bcf_fit.qmd`.
Only the respondent-level moderator set changes: it adds the post-game correlates.

Post-game items are correlates, not moderators. Every result built on them is an exploratory addendum.

::: callout-note
The BCF fits are the expensive step (each game is ~72k rows with `nburn + nsim = 2000`).
`cache: false` overrides the project-wide knitr cache: the fitted forest's `tree_samples` is a live Rcpp external pointer that does not survive cache serialize/reload.
Quarto `freeze: auto` still caches execution at the file level.
:::

# Variable definitions {#sec-vars}

`prof_mods` and `resp_mods` are the paper's frozen lists.
`resp_mods_ext` appends the post-game correlates, read from the variable dictionary, exactly as in `11_grf_fit_ext.qmd`.

```{r}
#| label: moderators
prof_mods <- c(
  "cj_nationality_shown",
  "der_cj_eu_identity",
  "der_cj_partisanship",
  "cj_age",
  "cj_sex",
  "cj_class"
)
resp_mods <- c(
  "q_gender",
  "q_age",
  "q_identity_country",
  "q_identity_eu",
  "q_identity_europe",
  "q_religion",
  "q_class",
  "q_eu_efficacy_understand",
  "q_pop_reps",
  "q_pop_goodevil",
  "q_pop_compromise",
  "q_dem_compromise",
  "q_dem_listen",
  "q_tech_experts",
  "q_tech_leaders",
  "q_party_harm",
  "q_people_incompetent",
  "q_eu_longterm",
  "q_eu_responsive",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_econ",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_cul",
  "q_eu_imp_nat_pol",
  "q_eu_abolish",
  "q_eu_satisfaction",
  "q_rural_urban",
  "q_edu_age_stop"
)
resp_mods_added <- var_dict_ext |>
  filter(!in_v1) |>
  pull(variable)
resp_mods_ext <- c(resp_mods, resp_mods_added)

stopifnot(
  # dictionary covers paper set
  all(resp_mods %in% var_dict_ext$variable),
  all(resp_mods_ext %in% names(dat))
)
```

`prep_game()` assembles the design for one game: outcome, treatment, IDs, and the numeric moderator matrix.

```{r}
#| label: prep-game
prep_game <- function(dat, game) {
  sub <- dat |>
    filter(cj_game_type == game) # full per-game sample (no subsampling)

  y <- sub$cj_pl2
  z <- as.integer(sub$cj_rel == "muslim") # Muslim vs all-else pooled
  country_id <- factor(sub$meta_country)
  respondent_id <- factor(sub$meta_pid)

  mod_df <- sub |>
    select(all_of(c(prof_mods, resp_mods_ext))) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.character), factor))
  sub_X <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = mod_df) # factors -> dummies

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(sub_X),
    all(z %in% c(0L, 1L)),
    !anyNA(y),
    nrow(sub_X) == length(y)
  )

  list(
    y = y,
    z = z,
    sub_X = sub_X,
    country_id = country_id,
    respondent_id = respondent_id
  )
}
```

`fit_bcf()` is unchanged from `05_bcf_fit.qmd`: country-only random intercepts, a single variance component, known conjoint propensity.

```{r}
#| label: fit-bcf
fit_bcf <- function(d) {
  # country-only random-intercept design, built inline
  # (the random_intercepts() helper has a known typo bug; get_dummies() is fine)
  country_dummies <- get_dummies(d$country_id) # n x C
  C <- ncol(country_dummies)
  Q_country <- matrix(1, nrow = C, ncol = 1) # single variance component

  stopifnot(
    nrow(country_dummies) == length(d$y),
    C == nlevels(d$country_id),
    C > 1 # else sampler disables REs
  )

  bcf_continuous_linear(
    y = d$y,
    z = d$z,
    x_control = d$sub_X, # numeric model matrix of moderators
    x_moderate = d$sub_X,
    zhat = rep(0.25, length(d$y)), # known conjoint propensity
    randeff_design = country_dummies,
    randeff_variance_component_design = Q_country,
    randeff_scales = 1, # length K = 1 (one component)
    randeff_df = 3,
    nburn = 1000,
    nsim = 1000,
    update_interval = 100
  )
}
```

# Dictator-game fit {#sec-dictator}

```{r}
#| label: fit-dictator
set.seed(20260604)
d_dict <- prep_game(dat, "cj_dict")
fit_dict <- fit_bcf(d_dict)
saveRDS(
  fit_dict,
  here::here("data", "03_final", "bcf_dictator_ext.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)
cat(sprintf("BCF dictator (extended) saved (n = %d).\n", length(d_dict$y)))
```

# Trust-game fit {#sec-trust}

```{r}
#| label: fit-trust
set.seed(20260605)
d_trust <- prep_game(dat, "cj_trust")
fit_trust <- fit_bcf(d_trust)
saveRDS(
  fit_trust,
  here::here("data", "03_final", "bcf_trust_ext.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)
cat(sprintf("BCF trust (extended) saved (n = %d).\n", length(d_trust$y)))
```
